item.description:
• Automatic boost: optionally boost on battery or when plugged in, and pause in Low Power Mode (menu › Automatic Boost)
  • Automatic updates via Sparkle (menu › Check for Updates…)
  • Fix: the gamma table now lifts the whole curve, so the image no longer looks washed out at high brightness
  • Note: if you're on 1.0, download this version manually once. Future updates will install automatically.
